[SWS_DM_01569] Configurable reset of the pendingDTC bit in case of displacement
⌈
If an event memory entry was removed during displace-
ment and the configuration parameter DiagnosticCommonProps.resetPending-
BitOnOverflow is set to "true", the DM module shall reset the UDS DTC status
bit 2 / ’pendingDTC’ to 0.
⌋
